en.title: Starting Scoring Sessions
en.excerpt: Unlocking scorekeeper field access, monitoring live end progress, and controlling session status.
en.content:
Session Status Lifecycle

Qualification sessions progress through three distinct operational states:

  • Scheduled: Targets allocated, but scorekeeper input locked.
  • In Progress: Scorekeepers actively entering arrow values at the shooting line.
  • Completed: Scoring concluded, results verified, and leaderboard finalized.

Unlocking Live Scoring

When line judges signal the start of official scoring, open the qualification session overview and click Start Session. Scorekeeper tablets immediately unlock the End 1 input keypad.

Live Field Progress Matrix

The organizer dashboard features a real-time field matrix showing every target butt from Target 1 to Target N. Green indicators highlight targets that have submitted their current end, while amber indicators identify targets still recording scores.

Weather Delays & Emergency Pauses

In the event of sudden rain or lightning delays, clicking Pause Session prevents accidental score submissions while archers seek shelter.
